evidence.detail: setup_decks shows 'Latest Tournament Top 8' from the most recent Gatherling competition — gets displaced by newer events (e.g. APAC) within hours
Issue comment proposes two alternatives: (a) reuse the same winner banner for Kick Off, (b) highlight all decks rather than just the winner — these are mutually exclusive product decisions
No special pinning logic for 500 or Kick Off results; homepage deck_tables always reflects the most recent competition

triage.notes: Two distinct design options are described in the issue comment. Owner needs to decide: pin the 500/Kick Off results for a fixed duration, show a winner banner, or highlight all top-8 decks. Implementation is straightforward once the design is chosen, but the design requires judgment.
